description: Memory architecture for the Myers Digital AIOS — how memory is structured, scoped, and maintained

session_memory.use_for: Working context for the current task

root_memory.use_for: Behavioral rules, routing map, active projects, core facts

CLAUDE.md.purpose: Behavioral instructions — HOW the agent acts

MEMORY.md.purpose: Active state — WHAT the agent knows right now

skill_memory.scope: Loaded on demand when skill is invoked
skill_memory.load_rule: Load ONLY the skill relevant to current task — never all skills at once

notion_memory.use_for: Client records, KPI history, decisions, hooks, coaching reports

archive_memory.scope: Historical reference — not loaded by default
archive_memory.use_for: Completed projects, resolved incidents, historical decisions

memory_rules: Always pull Notion context before routing (notion_read)
Always write back to Notion after any actionable decision (notion_write)
Behavioral rules belong in CLAUDE.md — never in MEMORY.md
Mutable facts and statuses belong in MEMORY.md — never in CLAUDE.md
No memory entry should exceed 2 sentences — compress verbose entries
Historical content moves to ARCHIVE.md after project completion
Workspace Architect audits memory files on demand — trigger via /webhooks/workspace/audit

compression_format.example_before: Summit Roofing is a Growth package client that signed on May 12, 2026. They are currently on Day 3 of their 10-day onboarding, with SMS sequences pending. Alex Rivera is handling the GHL build and the client seems engaged based on the kickoff call feedback received on May 13.
compression_format.example_after: Summit Roofing (Growth): Day 3/10 onboarding. SMS sequences pending — Alex Rivera assigned.
